name: Med-Dyne
old_description: As the leading provider of EEG, ECG, and Apnea Monitoring Supplies, Med-Dyne is committed to providing exceptional quality in every aspect.  We always aim to exceed our customers expectations.
about:
Med-Dyne operates from Louisville, Kentucky, where it was founded in 1996. The company has spent over three decades developing monitoring supplies for healthcare settings, though the founders are not named in public materials.

The company manufactures a range of disposable and reusable electrodes for pediatric ECG monitoring, adult and pediatric sleep testing, infant apnea monitoring, and EEG technology. Its product line includes disposable cup electrodes with silver/silver chloride sensors, prewired hydrogel electrodes using a patented hydrogel adhesive, and custom snap leadwire sets. Med-Dyne also offers custom design and packaging services, allowing facilities to specify color, length, and configuration. Orders ship the same day from a centrally located warehouse that maintains stock to eliminate backorders.

Med-Dyne serves hospitals, sleep labs, and pediatric care facilities across the medical industry. Its supplies are used in cardiac monitoring, sleep studies, and apnea detection for both infant and adult patients. The company emphasizes solutions for sensitive-skin patients, particularly neonates.

The business was built around a patented hydrogel adhesive designed to provide a firm yet gentle bond for fragile skin, addressing a gap the founders identified in existing monitoring electrodes. Med-Dyne states it continues to refine operations and provide innovative solutions tailored to facility needs, including expert guidance on product use.
